## Pull request overview

Adds a written evaluation of `@objectstack/client` against `@objectstack/spec` for low-code UI feasibility and updates the project roadmap to reflect the findings and new integration milestones.

**Changes:**
- Added `OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_EVALUATION.md` documenting protocol coverage, gaps, and a reference architecture.
- Updated `ROADMAP.md` with an evaluation summary section, new client-integration milestones, and updated auth status.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ROADMAP.md | Adds an `@objectstack/client` evaluation summary, updates current status items, and introduces Q1/Q2 integration milestone sections. |
| OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_EVALUATION.md | New comprehensive evaluation document with coverage tables, gap analysis, and setup examples. |

In the runtime initialization example, `authClient` is referenced but never created/imported, so the snippet can’t be followed as-is. Consider adding the minimal `createAuthClient({ baseURL: ... })` step (or note that you can pass `AuthProvider`’s client) so readers can wire `createAuthenticatedFetch` correctly.

`SchemaRenderer` does not consume a `dataSource` prop; it reads `dataSource` from `SchemaRendererProvider` context. As written, passing `dataSource={adapter}` won’t actually inject the adapter into expression evaluation / components, so the example is misleading. Update the snippet to wrap the tree in `SchemaRendererProvider dataSource={adapter}` (matching how the console uses it).

The metadata table marks “Hot Schema Reload” as ✅ complete, but the codebase currently only provides manual cache invalidation (`ObjectStackAdapter.invalidateCache()` / `MetadataCache.invalidate()`); there’s no automatic change detection/watch mechanism. Consider downgrading this to partial or clarifying that reload requires the app to explicitly invalidate cache and trigger a re-render.
```suggestion
| **Hot Schema Reload** | Manual cache invalidation + re-fetch | ⚠️ Partial | App must call `invalidateCache()` and trigger re-render; no automatic watch |
| **Dashboard Definitions** | Via app/stack metadata | ✅ Complete | `defineStack({ dashboards })` |
| **Report Definitions** | Via app/stack metadata | ✅ Complete | `defineStack({ reports })` |

**Metadata Layer Assessment: 95% — Core schema-driven architecture is supported; hot schema reload is manual (requires explicit cache invalidation and re-render) and automatic watch-based reload is planned.**
```

The auth capability table shows `ObjectStackAdapter({ token })` / `ObjectStackAdapter({ fetch })`, but `baseUrl` is a required constructor field. Consider adjusting the examples to include `baseUrl` so readers don’t copy a config shape that won’t type-check/work.
```suggestion
| **Token Authentication** | `ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl, token })` | Client constructor | ✅ Complete |
| **Dynamic Token Injection** | `ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl, fetch })` | Custom fetch wrapper | ✅ Complete |
```
